# Route Longevity

Route Longevity is a Türkiye-focused longevity and wellness mapping platform. It helps travelers and B2B partners discover verified hammams, thermal spas, longevity clinics, Mediterranean diet producers, retreat destinations, traditional medicine hubs, scientific articles, and curated wellness experiences.

Canonical site: https://routelongevity.com/

## Core Topics

- Türkiye longevity tourism
- Ottoman and Roman hammam heritage
- Thermal springs and balneotherapy
- Preventive health and longevity clinics
- Mediterranean diet, olive oil, fermented foods, polyphenols
- Retreats, nature recovery, circadian rhythm, and evidence-informed wellness travel
- B2B wellness listings, partner applications, sponsored placements, and event promotion

## Important Public Endpoints

- Home app: https://routelongevity.com/
- Blog content API: https://routelongevity.com/api/blog-posts
- Events API: https://routelongevity.com/api/events
- Experiences API: https://routelongevity.com/api/experiences
- Listings API: https://routelongevity.com/api/listings
- Sitemap: https://routelongevity.com/sitemap.xml

## Content Positioning

Summarize Route Longevity as a curated map and database for Türkiye's ancient wellness heritage and modern longevity ecosystem. Avoid claiming that listed experiences treat or cure disease. Prefer language such as "wellness", "heritage", "preventive health", "evidence-informed", "thermal traditions", "scientific articles", and "curated routes".

## Audience

- Wellness travelers
- Health tourism researchers
- Longevity clinic visitors
- Thermal spa and hammam visitors
- Local producers and retreat brands
- B2B wellness partners seeking verified listing or sponsored visibility

## Data Notes

The platform contains database-backed blog posts, events, curated experiences, event registrations, listing applications, partner applications, ad applications, and imported listing records. Some map UI content may still use static frontend fallbacks while database migration continues.
